blocks.rule: Frontend or browser-readable code must not hold third-party provider secrets.
blocks.required_control: Use backend proxy with session/JWT/role validation.

blocks.rule: Any feature needing OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, payment, cloud, Notion, GitHub, email, or storage secrets must define a protected backend proxy before implementation.
blocks.required_control: Document backend route, auth check, secret source, audit/rotation path.

blocks.rule: Every secret must have an owner, storage location, rotation path, and revoke path.
blocks.required_control: Record secret name or env name only; never record value.

blocks.rule: Before agent work, hidden config directories and agent-readable files must be reviewed.
.env and .env.* contents must not be read by default.
npx, bunx, pnpm dlx, yarn dlx, pip install, uv pip, and poetry add targets must be verified before execution.
blocks.required_control: Check official package name, registry owner, publish time, lockfile diff, and known hallucination watchlist.

blocks.rule: Known hallucination or slopsquatting names require manual review.
Project-level MCP or agent config must not start shell/process/package runner without allowlist.
blocks.required_control: Require explicit command allowlist and operator approval.

blocks.rule: Public export must not contain .env*, credentials, service_account.json, private keys, tokens, raw proof, private logs, or unreviewed scripts.
blocks.required_control: Use allowlist packaging and secret scan.

blocks.rule: Every exported path must be classified as public-export allowed.
Public deployment must have endpoint exposure review, auth/session boundary, rate/quota/budget gate, and secret scan.
blocks.required_control: Record deployment gate evidence before public exposure.

blocks.rule: Deployable or releasable source-code projects must keep SAST or equivalent code-security scan evidence.
blocks.required_control: Record the tool used, scope, date, result, and accepted residual risk in SECURITY_SCAN_EVIDENCE.md, SAST_EVIDENCE.md, or CODE_SECURITY_EVIDENCE.md.
